description: This PHP source file defines the SystemCheckAPI class within the OrangeHRM installer API namespace. It extends another SystemCheckAPI class and overrides the handleGet method to add additional system checks related to data encryption permissions.

classes.name: SystemCheckAPI
classes.description: A class extending the base SystemCheckAPI to implement an API endpoint for system checks during installation, specifically enhancing the check for data encryption directory permissions.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Overrides the base handleGet method to include additional verification for write permissions on the cryptography keys directory when data encryption is enabled.
